title: What is Wi-Fi 7, and do you need it?
metaDescription: What Wi-Fi 7 adds over Wi-Fi 6 and 6E, which devices can use it, and whether upgrading your router will make any difference at home.
excerpt: Wi-Fi 7 routers are now on sale. Here is what the new standard adds, and when it is worth upgrading.
answer: Wi-Fi 7 adds wider channels, faster modulation and the ability to use several bands at once. You only benefit if your phone or laptop also supports it and your broadband is fast.

media.alt: A Wi-Fi 7 router on a shelf with its status lights on

sections.heading: What changes
sections.body:
Wi-Fi 7 doubles the widest channel to **320MHz** in the 6GHz band.

- Faster modulation
- Multi-link operation

faq.q: Will a Wi-Fi 7 router work with old devices?
faq.a: Yes. Older devices connect using the standard they support.
